source.discharge: DIS_AV_CMS, long-term average natural discharge, modelled

flow_position.runoff_formation: inside a declared formation zone, upstream of its control section
flow_position.transit: inside the natural basin but below every declared control section
flow_position.endorheic_sink: terminal unit of the endorheic system (HydroBASINS ENDO = 2)

channel_class.ephemeral_or_dry: a channel is mapped but its long-term average flow is below that
channel_class.no_mapped_channel: no HydroRIVERS reach falls inside the unit

qualityNotes: DIS_AV_CMS is a modelled long-term average, not a gauge record; it classifies a channel, it does not measure this year's flow.
A mapped channel is not a flowing river: most of the Kyzylkum and Karakum units carry a HydroRIVERS line whose long-term average is below 0.1 m3/s.
Position and channel class are independent: a formation unit can be seasonally dry and a transit unit can be perennial.
